title: Probabilistic forecasting at scale
description: A hands-on workshop on quantile forecasts, rolling backtests, and conformal calibration with tscast. Bring a laptop; Python 3.12 recommended.
speaker: Dr. Amara Okafor

title: Causal inference for messy observational data
description: Prof. Vasquez walks through target trial emulation, negative controls, and what to do when the parallel trends assumption fails.
speaker: Prof. Elena Vasquez

title: Reproducibility clinic: fix your experiment
description: Bring a repository that will not reproduce. We will triage seeds, environments, data versions, and silent pipeline failures together.
speaker: R&A Committee

title: From notebook to package: shipping research code
description: Packaging, typing, tests, and the minimum viable release. A practical walkthrough of extracting tscast from a research repository.
speaker: Maya Chen

title: Simulation models for clinic operations
description: A guest lecture on discrete-event simulation, validation, and the gap between a clean model and a useful operational decision.
speaker: Dr. Kwame Mensah

title: Reading group: conformal prediction
description: A guided reading of split conformal methods, exchangeability, and the practical failure modes we see in deployed forecast systems.
speaker: Daniel Osei

title: Fall research kickoff + open problems
description: The committee presented six open problems for the semester and formed the project pods that became GridCast, CarePath, and CausalTwin.
speaker: R&A Committee
